regressions.what: The new soil face hides several cobbles visible at the foot of the previous bank, leaving a longer uninterrupted dark strip.

blockers.target: Muted olive-grey lake reflections give way to cool blue-grey ripple highlights over the visibly submerged gravel.
blockers.current: Blue and gold patches alternate across the lake, while the ochre gravel dominates the outlet so strongly that it looks exposed.
blockers.change: Reduce the gold reflection across the lake and carry broken blue-grey sky reflections between and below all three rocks while retaining visible gravel beneath.

blockers.target: Sunlit yellow-green grass tips stand out against olive foliage, including on the left bank.
blockers.current: Dark green and brown foliage merges across the left shoulder, and the right shoulder has only a few pale tips.
blockers.change: Lift the sunlit foliage by about 0.08 in normalized luminance and concentrate the yellow-green highlights on blade tips and the upper surfaces of shrub clumps.

blockers.where: A4 left cutbank and C3-D3 outlet rocks
blockers.target: Shaded soil and rock faces retain enough grey-brown light to show roots, stones and fractures.
blockers.current: The soil edge and downstream boulder faces contain broad near-black patches that erase surface relief.
blockers.change: Lift the ambient fill on the water-facing soil and boulders until individual stones and fractures remain visible in shadow.

next.where: A2-F3 waterline and both outer shoulders
next.target: Tall overlapping grass and shrubs extend to the frame edges, and low planted points interrupt the far shore and both near arcs.
next.current: The shrubs cluster halfway up the banks, and smooth exposed arcs still trace the nearly oval lake.
next.change: Extend dense grass stands to both frame edges and build several uneven planted points projecting into the water, with gravel tapering below their tips.

next.where: A3-B4 left cutbank and E3-F4 right beach
next.target: Roots drape over a sloping soil face above embedded cobbles opposite a convex ridge of overlapping grey gravel.
next.current: The left edge forms a steep continuous strip with a dark gap below, while the right beach is a pale flat band.
next.change: Slope the left face into a toe of partly buried cobbles, hang irregular roots from its lip, and build the right ridge from overlapping grey pebbles and fist-sized stones.

next.target: Low sloping rock flanks split the current into thin bright wakes that curl around each stone.
next.current: The larger rocks have near-vertical faces, and broad grey foam patches sit downstream with little white contact at the sides.
next.change: Bevel the steep faces and wrap narrow broken foam lines from the upstream contact around both flanks of each rock before letting them trail downstream.

excluded: Distant mountains and sky are outside this pass.
unverifiable: The still captures cannot establish the motion of the waterfall, ripples or wakes.
